_comment: What gate.py must do with each fixture. `rc` is the process exit code:
0 = both gates clean, 1 = a deterministic assertion failed, 2 = the run is
structurally unusable (cases missing / partial / a run errored / not one session trace
the gate could read), 3 = judge below
threshold while --enforce-judge is on. When several apply the HIGHEST code is returned.
Checked offline by scripts/check-eval-gate.py (check.sh section 9) so the split's logic
never needs a paid eval run to verify.

checks.name: a passing judge may not carry a failing deterministic assertion
a deterministic grader that passes one run and fails the other is a failure
a dissenting judge is reported as its own number, not a deterministic failure
--enforce-judge turns the same dissent into a hard failure with its own exit code
both gates clean passes, and tool_order counts as deterministic
fewer cases than exist on disk is a layout regression, not a pass
a run that errored before grading may not pass vacuously
must_contain: had a run that errored before grading

checks.name: a partial run fails even when everything it did grade passed
the real-Senzing case the CLI blended to 0.889 and passed is a deterministic failure here
traces declared but none readable is a structural failure, not a silent clean pass
structural + deterministic together report the HIGHEST code (2), not the last one set
must_contain: had a run that errored before grading
gate verdict: exit 2 — [1] deterministic assertion failed; [2] structural: a run errored before grading

checks.name: a run with no MCP tools is excluded from the plugin verdict, not scored by it
must_contain: structural: session had no Senzing MCP

checks.name: a handshake race (pending at init, then used the MCP) is a notice, not a structural failure
must_not_contain: structural: session had no Senzing MCP

checks.name: several llm graders in one case: a run's judge verdict is every-clause-passed, and the failing clause is named
--enforce-judge fails the multi-grader case on one red clause, exit 3
a 1-of-5 judge dissent above the threshold still names the clause and the run
